info.name: GuildChat API
info.description:
Every endpoint currently served by internal/router/router.go, in an order that runs end to end in the Collection Runner against an empty or a populated database.

Set baseUrl, then run the whole collection. The first request stamps a fresh runId, so accounts never collide between runs. Tokens and ids are captured into collection variables as they are created, so nothing has to be pasted by hand.

Three accounts are used throughout: A owns the room, B is a plain member, C is an outsider for the permission cases and is deleted at the end.
